name: io.github.lx1112/onchaincheck-prediction-markets
title: OnchainCheck Prediction Markets
description: Polymarket and Hyperliquid traders, smart money, market holders, flow, odds. Pay per call (x402)

tools.name: polymarket_trader_profile
tools.description: Who is this Polymarket trader and how do they trade? Pass a signer or Polymarket proxy wallet: name, X handle, account age, portfolio value, all-time P&L, volume and leaderboard ranks, the top 10 open positions (market, outcome, size, entry vs current price, P&L), the last 20 trades, and its record on resolved markets we tracked. Not advice. Costs $0.01 USDC on Base via x402.

address.description: The trader's wallet: the signer (EOA) or the Polymarket proxy wallet

tools.name: polymarket_market_holders
tools.description: Who is betting big on this Polymarket market, and are they any good? Pass a market slug, link or condition id: the biggest holders on each side (shares, value at the current price, name), the top 5 per side with their all-time P&L and leaderboard rank, and how many proven (profitable) traders sit on each side. Live from Polymarket's public data. Not advice. Costs $0.01 USDC on Base via x402.

market.description: A market slug (the last part of its polymarket.com URL), the URL itself, or a 0x condition id

tools.name: polymarket_smart_money
tools.description: Where are Polymarket's best traders putting money now? The busiest open markets by 24h volume (overall or one category) and which of the top 100 traders by day, week, month or all-time P&L are among each side's biggest holders: how many leaders per market, the side holding most of their money, value and price per side, and the leaders by name and X handle, plus our recorded track record: how often their side won in resolved markets. Not advice. Costs $0.02 USDC on Base via x402.

category.description: overall (default) or a Polymarket category such as crypto, politics, sports

tools.name: polymarket_top_traders
tools.description: Who are the best Polymarket traders right now? Top traders by P&L or volume for a day, week, month or all time, overall or in one category (crypto, politics, sports...): rank, wallet, name, X handle, P&L, volume, and portfolio value for the top 10. Then /polymarket/trader for one trader's positions. Live from Polymarket's public data. Costs $0.01 USDC on Base via x402.

category.description: overall (default) or a Polymarket category such as crypto, politics, sports, economics

tools.name: polymarket_trade_flow
tools.description: Who is placing the big bets on Polymarket right now? Pass a market (slug, link or condition id) or a category (its 5 busiest markets): every trade over minUsd in the last 1 to 24 hours, buys and sells per outcome, the biggest traders with their all-time P&L rank and X handle, and headlines such as "3 top-50 traders bought NO for $80k in the last 24 h". Live from Polymarket's public data. Not advice. Costs $0.01 USDC on Base via x402.

market.description: A market slug (the last part of its polymarket.com URL), the URL itself, or a 0x condition id

category.description: Instead of market: a Polymarket category (crypto, politics, sports, economy, tech)

minUsd.description: Smallest trade counted in USD, 100 to 1000000; default 1000

tools.name: polymarket_trader_alerts
tools.description: Webhook alerts when Polymarket traders trade, for 7 days: up to 5 wallets (signer or proxy) and a minimum size (default $500). We read each trader's trades about every 30 minutes and POST a signed JSON alert per new trade at or over that size: side, market, outcome, size, price, USD, tx. Returns an id and an HMAC secret; GET /watch/<id> is free. Renew with {id}. Not advice. Costs $0.05 USDC on Base via x402.

traders.description: Up to 5 Polymarket wallets (signer or proxy), comma-separated; omit when renewing

webhook.description: Public https URL that receives the alerts (POST, JSON); omit when renewing

minUsd.description: Smallest trade (shares x price, USD) that alerts; default 500, at least 10

id.description: Renew this subscription for 7 more days instead of creating one

tools.name: hyperliquid_trader_profile
tools.description: What is this Hyperliquid account holding and how is it trading? Open perp positions (coin, side, size, entry, mark, leverage, liquidation price, unrealized P&L, margin), account value and margin use, the last 24 h of fills per coin (count, volume, closed P&L, fees), its rank among the top 500 by day, week, month and all-time P&L, days on that leaderboard over 30 days and position changes over 24 h from our own records. Not advice. Costs $0.01 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: hyperliquid_smart_money
tools.description: Where are Hyperliquid's most profitable accounts positioned? Reads the open positions of the top 20 accounts by day, week, month or all-time P&L. For a coin: long vs short notional and account counts, size-weighted average entry per side, share of open interest, the biggest holders, and where their liquidation prices cluster above and below mark. Without a coin: their largest net exposures. Plus 24 h changes (flips, opens, closes) from our snapshots. Not advice. Costs $0.02 USDC on Base via x402.

coin.description: A Hyperliquid perp symbol such as BTC, ETH, HYPE; leave out for the top coins

window.description: Leaderboard window the top accounts are picked by; default month

tools.name: hyperliquid_markets
tools.description: Every Hyperliquid perpetual in one call: funding rate (hourly and annualized), open interest in USD, 24 h notional volume, 24 h change, mark and oracle price, premium and max leverage, sorted by |funding|, open interest, volume or move; funding of 50%+ a year either way is flagged, and the most positive and negative funding among $1M+ markets are listed. Costs $0.005 USDC on Base via x402.

sort.description: funding (by |annualized funding|), oi (default), volume or change (by |24 h move|)

tools.name: prediction_markets_search
tools.description: One search across Polymarket, Kalshi and Limitless: matching open markets with each venue's Yes/No price, volume, liquidity, close date and link. Where the same question trades on two venues (same numbers, close date and title words), both prices and the gap. Up to 3 Polymarket markets carry the smart-money tilt: which side the top 100 traders by monthly P&L hold among the biggest holders. Without q, the busiest markets. Live public data. Not advice. Costs $0.01 USDC on Base via x402.

q.description: Topic to search (fed rate, bitcoin 100k, election); omit for the busiest markets

category.description: Limit every venue to one category

tools.name: prediction_markets
tools.description: Prediction market odds for any topic from Polymarket: matching events with each market's outcomes and implied probabilities, 24-hour change, volume, liquidity and end date. For questions like 'odds of a Fed rate cut' or 'will bitcoin reach 150k'. Costs $0.005 USDC on Base via x402.

q.description: Topic to search (fed rate, bitcoin, election)

tools.name: perps_funding
tools.description: Perpetual futures funding across venues: every Hyperliquid perp with mark price, 24h change, open interest, volume and premium, and the current funding rate on Hyperliquid, Binance and Bybit, annualized, with the cross-venue spread (where to be long, where short). Sort by funding, spread, open interest, volume or move; filter by coin. Summary of the most positive and negative funding and the widest spreads. Costs $0.002 USDC on Base via x402.

coin.description: Up to 20 comma-separated symbols (BTC,ETH); default all

sort.description: apr (highest funding), -apr (most negative), abs-apr (default), spread, oi, volume, change

min_oi_usd.description: Leave out markets with less open interest (default 1000000 unless coins are named)

tools.name: x_handle_wallets
tools.description: Which wallets has this X (Twitter) account published? Looks the handle up in our index of Polymarket profiles that name an X account, read every 2 hours from Polymarket's public leaderboards and never pruned (indexSince says from when): each wallet (Polygon) with its Polymarket name, when we first and last saw it, and a profile link. Absence means not seen yet, not that the account has no wallet. No X access. Costs $0.02 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: x_accounts_polymarket_bets
tools.description: What crypto-X (Twitter) accounts are betting on Polymarket. Give an X handle, or get the top-ranked Polymarket traders who publish one: their trades in the last 1-168 h over a size you set (side, market, outcome, size, price, USD, tx), totals per market ("3 accounts bought Yes for $45k") and a merged feed. From our index of Polymarket profiles that name an X account, read every 2 hours, with each wallet's record on resolved markets. No X access. Not advice. Costs $0.01 USDC on Base via x402.

handle.description: X handle, with or without @; omit for the top-ranked accounts

tools.name: wallet_trader_pnl
tools.description: A wallet's trading P&L across venues: Hyperliquid (P&L, volume and return for day, week, month and all time, account value, open perp positions with notional, unrealized P&L and margin use) and Polymarket (P&L, volume and leaderboard rank per window, open positions' value, name and X handle), plus the combined P&L per window. Takes a signer wallet or a Polymarket proxy wallet. From the venues' public APIs. Not advice. Costs $0.01 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: example_output
tools.description: Free. Shows what a paid tool on this server returns: its price, an example input and the output captured from a real paid call. Tools: polymarket_trader_profile, polymarket_market_holders, polymarket_smart_money, polymarket_top_traders, polymarket_trade_flow, polymarket_trader_alerts, hyperliquid_trader_profile, hyperliquid_smart_money, hyperliquid_markets, prediction_markets_search, prediction_markets, perps_funding, x_handle_wallets, x_accounts_polymarket_bets, wallet_trader_pnl.

tool.description: Name of a paid tool on this server

tools.name: polymarket_big_trades
tools.description: Free. The five largest Polymarket trades of the last 24 hours that we recorded (trades of $5,000 and up on tracked markets): market, side, outcome, price, size in USD and the wallet. Look a wallet up with polymarket_trader_profile (paid).
